title: Identifying Seismic Anomalies Through Latitude‐ Longitude Mesh Analysis
content: Analysing seismic data with modern statistical methods has opened up the possibility of predicting major earthquakes and those of specific magnitudes. However, comprehensive analysis for each location is particularly labour-intensive, while such data necessitates continuous observation. It is therefore desirable to detect anomalies with ease. We demonstrate that this objective can be achieved not by examining complex regional ge-ometries, but simply by dividing the study area into a mesh. Moreover, unexpected properties emerged from the data collected in this manner, which we also present.
